title: Extraction and Deadline
author: Elodie Amberdale
blurb: Felix Underhill, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
